subject: af-con
title: AF.CON.------RE.ST.
description: Chart 3 of 3 on book p. 229 (WAC-27). AF-CON (affinity convergence) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; RE-ST (restructuralism) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-DY (information dynamics). From INFO-DY: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From LANG-DY: LG-EXT (logical extension) and AFL-DT (affinity dictates). From LG-EXT: POST (postulation). From AFL-DT: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From IF-ST-DY: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PROG-CONT: SOC-RT-INTR (social reality interpretation). From SOC-RT-INTR: INFO-DE (information degrees).
